metaDescription: Order custom bottle badge ID holders for your team. Perfect for bulk branding with your logo. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Bottle badge ID holders are designed to attach to water bottles, travel mugs, or gear bags, keeping IDs accessible during outdoor events, trade shows, or site visits. Made from durable vinyl or nylon, these holders offer clear visibility for badges while resisting moisture and wear. Choose from styles with hang holes, bulldog clips, or lanyard attachments to suit your team's daily use. Customize with your logo or text for a cohesive branded look across your organization.
